identity_boundary: One coherent Access application/AUD for browser claim and Managed OAuth MCP

implementation.protected_application: Hostname-based self-hosted application for the exact staging hostname, all paths, one AUD
implementation.public_exceptions: Separate more-specific hostname/path applications with Bypass / Include Everyone, limited to the exact list below

logging: No pairing codes, bearer tokens, cookies, keys, request bodies or HAR captures in evidence; verify actual provider logging settings
must_observe: Managed OAuth discovery and authenticated MCP on actual ChatGPT iPhone client
Unauthenticated /mcp and /pair/claim denied at the edge
Only exact reviewed public paths bypass Access; device/pairing paths retain their route-specific Worker authentication and rate limits
Health and ownership-challenge routes are intentionally public; an unconfigured challenge and disabled enrollment/control services return their expected refusal/404
No owner installation/device/public key in staging configuration
